The contract (KTR-V-005#7.2) explicitly permits partial deliveries, with the remainder billed after receipt. The quantities confirm this:

**Totals:** PO ordered 10/24/28/34. Two receipts: GR-...A (9/10) + GR-...B (9/21) = exactly 10/24/28/34 — the full PO.
- FK-2609-0296 (2026-09-12, after GR-A) billed 5/12/14/17 = GR-A.
- FK-2609-0298 (this invoice, 2026-09-22, after GR-B) bills 5/12/14/17 = GR-B.
- Cumulative invoiced = 10/24/28/34 = exactly total received. No over-billing.

Prices all match the PO exactly (1326100, 20900, 204600, 18900). This is a second delivery, not a resubmission.
